book.name: Tutui Masososaꞌ
book.title: Tutui Masososaꞌ Mulai neme Manetualain adu lalai no dae-bafoꞌ a

content: Yakob no kileoboboki nara rafafau fo sakaꞌ leo Masir reu
Basa ria, boe ma Yakob
nafafau ria hata-heto nara fo laꞌo ela Kanaꞌan. Losa koro Barseba, boe ma ana hala banda ela tao tutunu-hohotuꞌ fee Manetualain, fo riꞌ neme uluꞌ mai Isak doꞌo-tabe ni a.
Hatuꞌ esa boe ma Yakob nalamei. Nai meis ria, ana namanene Manetualain naloo ni nae, “Ae! Yakob! Yakob! O foa fo nenene dei!” Boe ma ana nataa nae, “Ubeaꞌ?”
Basa de Manetualain nae, “Au ia Manetualain fo riꞌ o papa ma doꞌo-taben neme uluꞌ mai so. O bosoꞌ bii leo Masir mu. Neuꞌ ko Au tao a tititi-nonosim dadi lahenda nusa bauinaꞌ rai naa.
Neuꞌ ko Au leo Masir uu sama-sama oo o. Ma neuꞌ ko Au oo faliꞌ tititi-nonosi mara leo dae Kanaꞌan reu. Fai bea ma o mate, neuꞌ ko anam Yusuf hapu hahae ma.”
Basa ria, boe ma Yakob no ana nara
foa ela koro Barseba. Ara fee ni no sao-ana nara saꞌe kareta fo riꞌ mane Masir a haitua so a.
Ara reni basa sira hata-posaka nara katemaꞌ, ma basa banda-manuꞌ fo dadi sira nuhuun so, nai dae Kanaꞌan. Basa de Yakob no ana toun, ana inan, upu-anan, ma soro-san, basa si leo Masir reu.
Yakob kileobobokin fo tuka leo Masir reu
Yakob kileobobokin
fo lali leo Masir reu nana, siꞌ: Ruben, ana uluꞌ a.

content.text: Ria ana nara siꞌ: Henok, Palu, Hesron, ma Karmi.
Simeon, no ana nara. Siꞌ: Yemuel, Yamin, Ohad, Yakin, ma Sohar. Ma Saul boe, fo Simeon saon lahenda Kanaꞌan a, anan.
Lewi, no ana nara. Siꞌ: Gerson, Kehat, ma Merari.
Yahuda, no ana nara. Siꞌ: Sela, Peres, ma Sera. Yahuda ana feke nara, Er no Onan, mate si rai Kanaꞌan so. Peres anan Hesron no Hamul tuka leo Masir boe.
Isaskar, no ana nara. Siꞌ: Tola, Pua, Ayub, ma Simron.
Sebulon, no ana nara. Siꞌ: Sered, Elon, ma Yahleel.

content: Sira basa nana, Yakob saon Lea anan fo boki si rai Mesopotamia. Ara ranuu ana inaꞌ boe, nade Dina. De Yakob no Lea tititi-nonosin basa si lahenda telu hulu telu.

content.text: Boe ma, anaꞌ reme sao feke na mai. Siꞌ: Gad no ana nara: Sifion, Hagi, Suni, Esbon, Eri, Arodi, ma Areli.
Aser, no ana nara. Siꞌ: Yimna, Yiswa, Yiswi, Beria, ma sira feto na, nade Sera.
Beria nanuu anaꞌ boe: Heber no Malkiel.

content: Sira basa, lahenda sanahulu nee. Sira nana Yakob no saon Silpa upu-anan. Silpa nana, riꞌ ata fo Laban fee ria ana feton Lea, Yakob sao ulu na.

content.text: Boe ma Yakob sao feken, nade Rahel. Ria boki na anaꞌ dua. Siꞌ: Yusuf no Benyamin.
Tepoꞌ ria, Yusuf sao Asnat nai Masir so. Arama na, malaka agama nai kota On. Ria nade Potifera. Yusuf no Asnat ana nara, siꞌ: Efraim no Manase.
Benyamin no ana nara boe tuka leo Masir reu. Siꞌ: Bela, Beker, Asibel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Ros, Mupim, Hupim, ma Ared.

content: Yakob no saon Rahel tititi-nonosi nara, lahenda sanahulu haa.
Yakob bei nanuu saoꞌ esa bali, nade Bilha. Ria boki naa anaꞌ dua, siꞌ Dan noo Naftali.

content.text: Naftali, no ana nara. Siꞌ: Yasel, Guni, Yeser, ma Silem.

content: Yakob no saon Bilha tititi-nonosi nara, lahenda hitu. Bilha nana, Rahel atan fo ana hapu neme papan Laban mai.
De, Yakob tititi-nonosin fo leo Masir reu nana, basa si lahenda nee hulu nee. Bei ta rekeꞌ manafeu nara.
Tamba Yusuf, no ana nara fo riꞌ boki si rai Masir, lahenda dua. De, Yakob no kileobobokin fo leo rai Masir a, basa si lahenda hitu hulu.
Yakob naneta seluꞌ no anan Yusuf
Tepoꞌ fo ara sakaꞌ losa Masir, boe ma Yakob nadenu anan Yahuda neu nauluꞌ, fo naloo Yusuf mai naneta no papa na nai Gosen. Ara losa rai Gosen,
boe ma Yusuf saꞌe na kareta na, fo neu naneta no papa na, nai naa. Ara raneta, boe ma Yusuf holu na papa na, de ana dola doo na seliꞌ.
Basa boe ma Yakob dedea no Yusuf nae, “Yusuf, ee! Besaꞌ ia, au ita mataꞌ o so. Ma au bubuluꞌ so, o bei masoda. Huu ria na, leo mae besaꞌ ia au mate boe, malole a.”
Boe ma Yusuf nafada basa aꞌa-fadi nara nae, “Au muste u afada maneꞌ a ae, au kileoboboki kara reme Kanaꞌan mai so.
Boe ma neuꞌ ko au afada ae, emi nana lahenda manamaboi bibi-lopo ma sapi. Huu ria na, de emi meni basa banda-manuꞌ, ma posaka mara reme Kanaꞌan mai.
Maneniko maneꞌ a naloo emi, ma natane nae emi biasa moi-tao nonoi ubeaꞌ,

sona mataa ni mae, emi basa ia manamaboi banda meme aana mara mai, sama leoꞌ emi bei-baꞌi mara, fo ela ana nadenu emi leo nai dae Gosen.” Yusuf nafada nae leoꞌ na, nana huu maneniko lahenda Masir leo rabua ro manafoo ra, sona ara rahiaꞌ.

footnotes.text: Susura Makamoiꞌ dedea Ibrani nae, “Israel nafafau boe ma laꞌo.”
Susura Makamoi dedea Ibrani nae, “Israel ana nara roo sira papan Yakob.”
Susura Makamoi dedea Ibrani nae, “Israel kileobobokin”.
Lahenda sira hitu hulu, nana reke reni Yakob no Yusuf rai daleꞌ so.
